title: Alegia · El tejado del 61 ya no tapa la plaza
description: docs/graphics.md § Seeing Gerard behind things, src/geo-scenery.ts `SINK`, src/building-occlusion.ts `buildingHidesGround`. By Marta's piano the house at number 61 hid half the square under its roof without hiding Gerard himself, so it stood whole. A building marked `cut: "foundations"` now comes down while it hides him or the ground a few steps round him; out in front on San Juan kalea both it and the town hall still stand whole. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: if (!window.downs()[0]) throw new Error('By the piano, number 61 must be down: its roof hides the square')

steps.caption: Junto al piano: la casa del 61, delante de la plaza, baja a sus cimientos
